speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) whether Sport Singapore and national sports associations have developed programmes and training to advise talented Singapore athletes who may be considering professional sporting careers; and (b) if so, whether there is a comprehensive support system for athletes that advises them on preparations, what to expect and contract negotiations and whether Singaporean athletes are aware of such training and support systems.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Sports have the power to rally and unite a nation, and we want to see Singaporeans achieve their full potential.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: They include former national athletes, such as shuttler Derek Wong, who has made a successful transition to a post-sport career with Deloitte.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Athlete Life Coaching is also provided to guide athletes in their education pathway, as well as support for school admissions and scholarship applications.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In the course of striving for sporting excellence, some athletes may consider pursuing professional sporting careers.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: As the decision to turn professional is a personal choice, this is best left to the athlete to decide in consultation with the family, the manager, if he or she has appointed one, and the respective NSAs.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: SportSG shares with the athletes the key considerations for turning professional and provides resources.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Our Team Singapore athletes are aware that they can avail themselves of all these programmes we have put in place to support their overall well-being as they pursue excellence in sports.
